<div class="card-body">
'''Restraining Bolt (Dark)''' is a [[Dark]] [[Device]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">行動規制ボルト</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">任意の位置カード上の好きなドロイドに配備する。そのドロイドは移動できず、カードルールを使用できない。同じ位置に別のドロイドがいれば、自分の支配フェイズに行動規制ボルトを（フォースを消費せずに）そのドロイドへ再配備できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Restraining-Bolt-Dark-SWCA-100702.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">融合溶接器を使ってドロイドが内包する専用ソケットに固定接続する。ボルトはドロイドの回路を支配し、命令に逆らった場合にはその動きを停止させる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Restraining Bolt (Dark).

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on any droid you choose at any location card. That droid cannot move or use its card rules. If another droid is at the same location, you may redeploy the Restraining Bolt to that droid during your control phase without spending Force.

'''Lore:'''
It is fixed to a special socket built into a droid using a fusion welder. The bolt controls the droid’s circuits and stops its movement if it disobeys orders.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Transfer is during 支配フェイズ (control phase), not the deploy phase, and is 再配備.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Restraining Bolt (Dark)]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
